Date/time/location/fee form one continuous group; sewing thread sweeps back to deadline and URL. The smallest fee/time retain readable symbols at this display.
Chair and two adult faces occupy center; close foreground fabric and arms occupy lower edge. The right title dominates the invitation somewhat.

substantive_visual.observation: Two neighbors actively stabilize/turn a tool at one chair; foreground hands sew one patched blue garment.
